cards.front: Quickest way to see every Control Panel applet alphabetically (no Categories)?
cards.back: Change the view from Category to Small icons or Large icons.

cards.front: Why might the Mail icon be missing from the Control Panel?
cards.back: It only appears after a supported email client (e.g. Microsoft Outlook) is installed.

cards.front: Which Control Panel applet contains the proxy server settings (LAN Settings)?
cards.back: Internet Options > Connections > LAN Settings.

cards.front: Where in Control Panel do you change the virtual memory paging file?
cards.back: System > Advanced System Settings > Performance Settings > Advanced > Virtual Memory.

cards.front: Where do you turn Windows features (like IIS, Hyper-V) on or off?
cards.back: Control Panel > Programs and Features > 'Turn Windows features on or off' (left sidebar).

cards.front: Two profiles built into Windows Defender Firewall by default?
cards.back: Private network and Public network (a Domain profile also appears when joined to a domain).

cards.front: Which Control Panel applet manages local user accounts and UAC settings?
cards.back: User Accounts.

cards.front: Which Device Manager tab shows when a driver was last updated?
cards.back: Events.

cards.front: What does Indexing Options do?
cards.back: Controls which folders and file types Windows Search indexes for fast lookup.

cards.front: Three tabs in File Explorer Options?
cards.back: General, View, Search.

cards.front: Where do you toggle 'show hidden files' and 'hide file extensions'?
cards.back: Control Panel > File Explorer Options > View tab.

cards.front: Difference between Hibernate and Sleep / Standby?
cards.back: Hibernate saves state to DISK (no power needed, slower resume). Sleep keeps state in RAM (needs power, fast resume).

cards.front: What is Fast Startup in Windows?
cards.back: A hybrid behavior where Windows hibernates the kernel session instead of fully shutting down, so the next boot is much faster. Can be disabled in Power Options.

cards.front: What option controls the laptop closing behavior (sleep, hibernate, do nothing)?
cards.back: Power Options > 'Choose what closing the lid does'.

cards.front: Which Settings category has the option to use Active Hours so Windows Update doesn't interrupt the workday?
cards.back: Windows Update (under Settings or Update and Security in Windows 10).

cards.front: Where do you set the system to get date and time automatically?
cards.back: Settings > Time and Language > Date and Time > Set time automatically.

cards.front: Why does time accuracy matter on a corporate Windows machine?
cards.back: Active Directory authentication uses Kerberos, which fails if system clocks drift too far apart.

cards.front: Which Settings category contains Xbox Game Bar config?
cards.back: Gaming.

cards.front: Which Settings category contains microphone, camera, and location permissions per app?
cards.back: Privacy and Security (Privacy in Windows 10).

cards.front: Where do you uninstall an installed application via Settings?
cards.back: Settings > Apps.

cards.front: Which Control Panel applet does the Sound icon manage?
cards.back: Playback and recording devices (speakers, microphones) and which is default.
